symptom: Inherited required fields and non-enumerable own fields can be accepted by validation while canonical JSON digest ignores them; accessor fields may throw during validation.
lesson: Validation and canonical hashing must agree on exactly which fields exist and which values are hashed.
guardrail: Require every record field to be an enumerable own data property with a string key; require all kind-specific fields and finite metrics data fields to satisfy the same shape before append classification.
